description: This Java source file defines the ImageTransform class, which provides static utility methods for reading, scaling, and transforming images, as well as parsing XML configuration files related to image properties within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ImageTransform
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for image processing tasks such as reading, scaling, converting, and parsing image-related XML configurations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getBufferedImage
methods.description: Reads an image from the specified file location and returns a map containing either an error message or the BufferedImage object.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Scales a BufferedImage based on specified dimensions from a configuration map and a size type, returning the scaled image and related data.

methods.name: getXMLValue
methods.description: Parses an XML configuration file to extract image property values into a map structure.

methods.name: toBufferedImage
methods.description: Converts a generic Image instance into a BufferedImage of a specified type.
